profile.headline: Software Engineer Apprentice at Intuit
profile.summary:
My career foundation is built on unlocking potential—first in the classroom, and now through technology. My background in Philosophy from Rutgers University honed my ability to deconstruct complex problems logically, a skill I applied directly as an educator to help students in under-resourced communities achieve their goals. Driven by data to enhance student engagement, I discovered a deeper passion for building the tools that drive outcomes, not just using them.

This curiosity led me to pursue technical mastery, earning certifications like the AWS Cloud Practitioner and immersing myself in a rigorous full-stack software development program at App Academy. Here, I am building a robust foundation in modern technologies like JavaScript, Python, React, and Docker, with a focus on creating intuitive, user-centric applications.

I am now seeking to merge my unique perspective—bridging human-centered problem-solving with technical execution—into a collaborative engineering team. My goal is to contribute to products that empower users and simplify complex challenges, and to grow within a culture that values continuous learning and impactful innovation.

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description: After completing a software engineering bootcamp through Black Genius Academy (sponsored by Google), I taught high school math at KIPP Cooper Norcross Academy for one year before transitioning to a Program Specialist role at Big Brothers Big Sisters. These experiences strengthened my communication, empathy, and ability to serve diverse communities — skills I now bring to software engineering as an apprentice at Intuit.

projects.title: GoGather
projects.description:
LIVE LINK: https://gogather.onrender.com/
A full-stack event management platform built with React and Express.js that enables users to discover, create, and register for events. Features secure user authentication, dynamic search and filtering, and comprehensive CRUD functionality for events, registrations, and favorites. Implemented a robust PostgreSQL database with RESTful API architecture to handle complex user interactions and real-time event data management.

projects.title: Warbnb
projects.description:
Live Link: https://api-project-bnb.onrender.com

A full-stack marketplace developed with React and Express.js, offering a seamless platform for booking unique accommodations. It features a robust PostgreSQL database for managing listings, reservations, and user data. The platform includes advanced filtering options to help users find the perfect stay, along with secure login and sign-up functionalities to personalize the experience. Additionally, users can leave reviews and ratings, enhancing the community-driven aspect of the platform. The immersive, responsive design ensures a smooth user experience across all devices, making it easy to browse, book, and manage reservations from anywhere.

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity Incorporated
organizations.description:
Mission Statement 
Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. develops leaders, promotes brotherhood and academic excellence, while providing service and advocacy for our communities.


Vision Statement 
The objectives of this Fraternity shall be: to stimulate the ambition of its members; to prepare them for the greatest usefulness in the causes of humanity, freedom, and dignity of the individual; to encourage the highest and noblest form of manhood; and to aid down-trodden humanity in its efforts to achieve higher social, economic and intellectual status.
